answer: Anchor each agent to the unique GNSS multipath fingerprint its antenna hears at a fixed spot: a raven perched on a harbor jetty scatters satellite echoes one way, a rooftop another. The network challenges you to echo back that faint positional whisper live, and many clones crammed at one location all return the same signature and collapse into a single admitted identity, so faking N agents demands N genuinely dispersed physical sites with real hardware.
